title: Alianza para el Progreso
goal: Read how the Alliance for Progress began in March 1961 to counter the Cuban Revolution, why local elites resisted its reforms, and how US enthusiasm faded after Vietnam and the 1969 change of administration.
grammar: A raíz de: el origen de un cambio

items: State when and why Kennedy convened the hemisphere's diplomats in 1961.
Explain how local landowners and bankers reacted to the program's reforms.
Explain why US enthusiasm for the program declined by the late 1960s.
Describe what happened to the program after the 1969 change of administration.
Use a raíz de to introduce the origin of a later change.
